20361-the-voice-of-the-machines-an-intro.title: An Introduction to the Twentieth Century
20361-the-voice-of-the-machines-an-intro.creator: Unknown
20361-the-voice-of-the-machines-an-intro.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In its present importance as a factor in life and a modifier of its conditions, the machine is in every sense a new and unprecedented fact. The machine has no traditions. The only way to take a traditional stand with regard to life or the representation of life to-day, is to leave the machine out. It has always been left out. Leaving it out has made little difference.

arxiv-2011-04679.title: The Semi-Classical Regime for Dark Matter Self-Interactions
arxiv-2011-04679.creator: Brian Colquhoun, Saniya Heeba, Felix Kahlhoefer, Laura Sagunski, Sean Tulin
arxiv-2011-04679.description: Abstract Many particle physics models for dark matter self-interactions—motivated to address long-standing challenges to the collisionless cold dark matter paradigm—fall within the semi-classical regime, with interaction potentials that are long-range compared to the de Broglie wavelength for dark matter particles.

arxiv-2102-05185.title: Benchmarks, Algorithms, and Metrics for Hierarchical Disentanglement
arxiv-2102-05185.creator: Andrew Slavin Ross, Finale Doshi-Velez
arxiv-2102-05185.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrew Slavin Ross, Finale Doshi-Velez. In representation learning, there has been recent interest in developing algorithms to disentangle the ground-truth generative factors behind a dataset, and metrics to quantify how fully this occurs. However, these algorithms and metrics often assume that both representations and ground-truth factors are flat, continuous, and factorized, whereas many real-world generative processes involve rich hierarchical structure, mixtures of discrete and continuous variables with dependence between them, and even varying intrinsic dimensionality.

arxiv-2301-13688.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shayne Longpre Le Hou Tu Vu Albert Webson Hyung Won Chung. We study the design decisions of publicly available instruction tuning methods, and break down the development of Flan 2022 models ( Chung et al. Through careful ablation studies on the Flan Collection of instruction tuning tasks and methods , we tease apart the effect of design decisions that enable Flan-T5 to outperform prior work by 3-17%+ across evaluation settings.

arxiv-2303-05968.description: Abstract This paper studies a general class of social choice problems in which agents’ payoff functions (or types) are privately observable random variables, and monetary transfers are not available. We consider cardinal social choice functions which may respond to agents’ preference intensities as well as preference rankings.

arxiv-2407-14947.title: A Distributionally Robust Optimization Framework for Stochastic Assessment of Power System Flexibility in Economic Dispatch
arxiv-2407-14947.creator: Xinyi Zhao, Lei Fan, Fei Ding, Weijia Liu, Chaoyue Zhao
arxiv-2407-14947.description: Abstract Given the complexity of power systems, particularly the high-dimensional variability of net loads, accurately depicting the entire operational range of net loads poses a challenge. To address this, recent methodologies have sought to gauge the maximum range of net load uncertainty across all buses.

arxiv-2511-11250.title: Prompt Engineering vs. Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Vulnerability Detection in Solana and Algorand Smart Contracts
arxiv-2511-11250.creator: Biagio Boi, Christian Esposito
arxiv-2511-11250.description: Abstract Smart contracts have emerged as key components within decentralized environments, enabling the automation of transactions through self-executing programs. While these innovations offer significant advantages, they also present potential drawbacks if the smart contract code is not carefully designed and implemented.

europmc-pmc4698281.creator: McKee AC, Cairns NJ, Dickson DW, Folkerth RD, Keene CD, Litvan I, Perl DP, Stein TD, Vonsattel JP, Stewart W, Tripodis Y, Crary JF, Bieniek KF, Dams-O'Connor K, Alvarez VE, Gordon WA, TBI/CTE group.

Like many other neurodegenerative conditions, at present, CTE can only be definitively diagnosed by post-mortem...

pmc-10695509.title: Systemic and targeted steroids for the treatment of IgA nephropathy
pmc-10695509.creator: Francesco Locatelli, Lucia Del Vecchio, Claudio Ponticelli
pmc-10695509.description: Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) is a common glomerulonephritis partially correlated with mucosal immune system dysfunction. Progressive renal failure occurs in many patients, with about 30–50% of the patients with IgAN developing end-stage kidney disease (ESKD). Many treatments have been used for decades, despite uncertainty about their effectiveness and the ideal dose.

pmc-11357404.title: Cytotoxic and Anti-HSV-1 Effects of Caulerpin Derivatives
pmc-11357404.creator: Gisely Maria Freire Abílio, Cicera Janaine Camilo, Henrique Douglas Melo Coutinho, José Galberto Martins da Costa, Lindomar José Pena, Abelardo Silva-Júnior, Yuri Mangueira do Nascimento, José Maria Barbosa-Filho, Bárbara Viviana de Oliveira Santos, Kristerson Reinaldo de Luna Freire
pmc-11357404.description: Marine organisms represent a potential source of secondary metabolites with various therapeutic properties. However, the pharmaceutical industry still needs to explore the algological resource. The species Caulerpa lamouroux Forssk presents confirmed biological activities associated with its major compound caulerpin, such as antinociceptive, spasmolytic, antiviral, antimicrobial, insecticidal, and cytotoxic.

pmc-11453801.title: 9371 Insult To Injury: A Rare Presentation Of Graves’ Disease With Acute Pericarditis
pmc-11453801.creator: Kamal Shaik, Atika Nayeem, Anas Kartoumah, Jad Alsheikh, Mohamad Hosam Horani
pmc-11453801.description: Disclosure: K. Shaik: None. A. Nayeem: None. A. Kartoumah: None. J. Alsheikh: None. M.H. Horani: None. Introduction: Graves' disease is an autoimmune condition that primarily causes hyperthyroidism. Its impact often extends to the cardiovascular system, causing complications such as atrial fibrillation and tachycardia. However, the co-occurrence of acute pericarditis is unusually rare and underreported.

pmc-11610169.title: Anatomical and functional outcome of surgical correction of optic disc pit maculopathy using autologous scleral patch graft: a long-term retrospective analysis
pmc-11610169.creator: Naresh Babu Kannan, Avik Dey Sarkar, MuthuKrishnan Vallinayagam, Swikruti Jena, Shraddha Shah, Kim Ramasamy
pmc-11610169.description: BackgroundOptic disc pit (ODP) is a rare congenital anomaly of optic nerve head and is associated with maculopathy. Scleral patch graft (SPG) as a therapeutic option is recently advocated.MethodsThis is a retrospective analysis of 54 patients with ODP maculopathy who were followed up for 12 months post-operatively.

pmc-12621126.title: Longitudinal variability of blood eosinophils impact lung function decline in the general population
pmc-12621126.creator: Charmaine J.M. Lim, Oliver Helk, Robab Breyer-Kohansal, Marie-Kathrin Breyer, Emiel F.M. Wouters, Sylvia Hartl
pmc-12621126.description: BackgroundBlood eosinophil counts (BECs) show moderate fluctuations over time but their long-term variability and clinical relevance in the general population remain unclear. We hypothesise a temporal variation of BECs over two visits (V1 and V2; 4.3±0.6 years) in the population-based Austrian LEAD study.

pmc-13099571.title: How to destroy “forever chemicals” for good
pmc-13099571.creator: Amy McDermott
pmc-13099571.description: ove and ultimately destroy persistent and potentially dangerous forever chemicals. Image credit: Shutterstock/kittirat roekburi. It’s one of many studies sounding alarms about the serious health risks posed by forever chemicals—the infamous molecules also known as perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

pmc-13118782.title: Optimized Protocols to Extract Total Transcripts and Proteins from Lipid-Rich Tissues
pmc-13118782.creator: Nicolas De Azevedo, Anthony Lozano, Ramon E. Parsons, Tiphaine C. Martin
pmc-13118782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Highly lipidic tissues (e.g., adipose tissue, brain, and liver) are challenging for transcript and protein extraction and for next-generation sequencing. Lipids can clog filters, columns, and pipettes; cause autofluorescence and quenching in imaging; and interfere with centrifugation-based separation. Aim: To identify the most suitable method for extracting total RNA for RT-qPCR and an alternative method for extracting total protein for quantification in mice fed a regular or high-fat diet.

pmc-13406834.title: Boiogito Ameliorates Inflammation-Associated Adipocyte Dysfunction and Restores Adipogenesis in Association with Suppression of NF-κB Signaling
pmc-13406834.creator: Yi Luo, Ailing Hu, Jingya Lu, Wenshu Yuan, Yu Tan, Takuji Yamaguchi, Zenji Kawakami, Yasushi Ikarashi, Yoshinao Harada, Hiroyuki Kobayashi
pmc-13406834.description: Boiogito (BOT), a traditional Kampo herbal medicine, has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and anti-obesity properties. However, its potential role in protecting adipocyte function under inflammatory conditions at different stages of adipocyte development remains unclear. This study investigated the effects of BOT on adipogenesis and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α)-induced inflammatory responses in differentiating and mature 3T3-L1 adipocytes.

pmc-13420597.title: Posteroseptal RVOT PVCs in a Clockwise-Rotated Congenital Heart
pmc-13420597.creator: Adithya Shastry, Lung En Teng, Robert D. Anderson
pmc-13420597.description: BackgroundElectrocardiography (ECG) localization of ventricular arrhythmias assumes normal cardiac anatomy. In cases of adult congenital heart disease, surgical remodeling can confound traditional algorithms.CaseA 26-year-old male with repaired pulmonary atresia and ventricular septal defect presented with a 17% premature ventricular complexes burden. The ECG showed right bundle branch block morphology, inferior axis, and positive precordial concordance, classically suggesting a left-sided origin.

pmc-13449497.title: Colchicine attenuates kidney injury by modulating the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway
pmc-13449497.creator: Gyuri Kim, Ga Young Heo, Bo Young Nam, YooJin Cho, Je Wook Yu, Cheol Ho Park, Hyung Woo Kim, Jung Tak Park, Tae-Hyun Yoo, Shin-Wook Kang, Seung Hyeok Han
pmc-13449497.description: BackgroundColchicine, a well-known anti-inflammatory drug, has emerged as a therapeutic option in various inflammatory diseases. However, its role in chronic kidney disease (CKD) remains unclear. This study aims to investigate the reno-protective effects of colchicine in an experimental CKD model and its potential role in modulating the NOD-like receptor, pyrin domain containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome pathway.

pmc-13665750.title: Preliminary Investigations into the Possibility of Using Hot Torsion Testing to Model Microstructural Evolution During Aluminum Extrusion
pmc-13665750.creator: Piotr Korczak, Konrad Błażej Laber, Sonia Boczkal, Dariusz Leśniak, Krzysztof Remsak
pmc-13665750.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This paper outlines preliminary findings from studies on the possibility of using hot torsion testing for the physical modeling of microstructural evolution during aluminum alloy extrusion processes. Accordingly, two plastic deformation processes were investigated: high-temperature torsion and extrusion. The studies were conducted within the temperature range characteristic of the extrusion of 16 mm diameter round profiles made of EN AW-6060 aluminum alloy, with different cooling rates after deformation.
